candidate: Rana sylvatica breeding-count reappearance across 64 Yale-Myers Forest ponds

publication.citation: Rowland et al. (2022), Asynchrony, density dependence, and persistence in an amphibian

response_header_firewall.acquisition: one independently verified HTTP Range request per byte, stopping on the first CR or LF

published_aggregate_evidence.source: Dryad metadata and Rowland et al. article-level study description only
published_aggregate_evidence.note: The release documents 64 ponds over 2000-2020 and 1130 response rows, but publishes no split-specific observed zero-to-positive or zero-to-zero counts for this frozen endpoint. General egg-mass totals and zero counts are not substituted.

pre_response_allowed: official tokenized four-file manifest with ephemeral URLs retained only in memory
the bounded physical header of woodfrogdata.csv through one-byte Range reads
pre_response_forbidden: any data row or value in woodfrogdata.csv
the dynamically assembled whole-version ZIP body
any mirror or derivative containing row-level egg-mass outcomes

source_identity.file_identity: exact filename + byte size + SHA-256 for all four version files

node_geometry.registry_rule: the 64 ordered row labels and 64 ordered column labels in distance.mat.csv must be identical; pondinfo.csv Pond.ID must join one-to-one to that set

response_semantics.risk_set: pond with a finite released Avg.RASY.Count equal to zero at source year t and a finite released Avg.RASY.Count at the consecutive target year t+1
response_semantics.event: risk-set pond has released Avg.RASY.Count greater than zero at t+1
response_semantics.non_event: risk-set pond has released Avg.RASY.Count equal to zero at t+1
response_semantics.source_state: all closed-registry ponds with finite released Avg.RASY.Count greater than zero at t
response_semantics.missingness: missing row or nonfinite Avg.RASY.Count makes that pond-transition unavailable; no interpolation, carry-forward, zero fill, or alias repair
response_semantics.count_validation: Avg.RASY.Count must be finite and nonnegative whenever used; positive means strictly greater than zero
response_semantics.boundary: observed whole-pond breeding-count reappearance, not latent occupancy, demographic immigration, parentage, or a reconstructed colonization history
response_semantics.categorical_token_schema: none; Pond.ID must exactly match the closed nonresponse registry and numeric fields use strict finite parsing

temporal_split.fit_policy: fit exactly once on pooled eligible calibration risk rows; never refit on heldout outcomes
temporal_split.sequential_layer_a_policy: calibration outcomes update Layer A after each calibration prediction design; each heldout year is scored before that year's outcomes may update Layer A for the next year

count_gate.failure_action: write immutable non-estimable result with zero fits and zero heldout scores

process_source.system: 64 monitored nonpermanent freshwater ponds in the 3212-ha Yale-Myers Forest
process_source.conditioning_boundary: the predictive claim is explicitly conditional on realized current-year positive ponds inside the closed 64-pond monitoring registry
process_source.external_sources: not represented; the endpoint is not interpreted as physical immigration and no external source is added after response access
process_source.persistence: same-node possible-source persistence is admitted in the response-blind temporal closure audit
process_source.transition_relation: the full-support exponential world permits every distinct internal pond pair; hard worlds remain falsifiable submodels
process_source.published_context: female site fidelity after first breeding is high, while a small juvenile fraction may disperse up to 2000 m before first breeding
process_source.claim_limit: internal source-conditioned predictive support, not biological source closure or ancestry

world_scale.kernel_scale_basis: the publication's response-independent 500-m neighboring-pond density window; used as an analytical decay scale, not a dispersal limit
world_scale.threshold_interpretation: minimal response-blind structural LCC regimes, not fitted movement distances

layer_a_rules.current_sources: all finite positive Avg.RASY.Count ponds at source year t
layer_a_rules.source_weights: equal normalized weight across current internal sources
layer_a_rules.hard_world_support: exp(-distance/500) for distinct pairs at or below the frozen LCC threshold, otherwise zero
layer_a_rules.full_world_support: exp(-distance/500) for every distinct pond pair
layer_a_rules.transition_normalization: Q[s,j]=W[s,j]/(1+sum_k W[s,k]); target support is the equal-current-source mean of Q[s,j]
layer_a_rules.update: after each observed transition, eliminate a surviving hard rule if any newly positive risk-set target has support at or below 1e-15; the full-support rule is evaluated by the same unchanged rule
layer_a_rules.monotonicity: worlds may only remain or be eliminated; eliminated worlds never return
layer_a_rules.all_eliminated: stop and report frozen-universe falsification without scale or source rescue

comparators.baseline: frozen strong random-forest learner with conventional static pond, annual climate/hydrology, response-independent geometry, and lagged source-state predictors
comparators.augmented: the identical frozen learner and identical conventional predictors plus the unchanged ten-column Layer-B block

preprocessing_model_fit.missing_value_policy: numeric medians learned on calibration rows only and applied unchanged to heldout rows; explicit missing-indicator columns are frozen; an all-missing calibration feature stops before fit
